QuestInfo.name: [Limina] Final Operation
QuestInfo.0:
It seems the final operation is ready.
All that remains is your decision.
QuestInfo.1:
There was unrest, confusion, and fear in everyone's heart.
Empress Cygnus noticed this and raised her voice to give strength to everyone.
There was only one thing left after our hesitation was gone. And that was to defeat the #rBlack Mage#k.
